g.text: Sonicate ITO glass in five solvent baths
Selected operation defines the material and layer
Illustrative plane · no inferred stack or dimensional scale
Inputs: ITO-coated glass substrate; Acetone; Deionized water; Isopropanol
Output: Sonicate ITO glass in five solvent baths
Use acetone, deionized water, acetone, isopropanol and acetone, in that order, for 15 min
each. Bath volumes and sonicator settings are not reported.
Qualified action illustration; no unreported vessel dimensions, hardware, measured
molecular geometry, or experimental trace is implied.
